Quality.metaDescription: Certifications and approvals by market, individual traceability from the farm to the box, animal welfare and quality control at the Sarandí del Yí plant.
Quality.title: Food safety and traceability, from ear tag to box
Quality.lead: Every box that leaves the plant can be traced back to the animal and its farm of origin. We work under official veterinary inspection and hold the certifications each market requires.

certs.title: Certifications and approvals
certs.lead: Illustrative badges for this demo site: they are not official logos or seals of the certification bodies.

certification.title: Certifications
certification.lead: Food safety standards and religious certifications, audited by external bodies.

approval.title: Market health approvals
approval.lead: Each destination approves the plant separately, with its own health controls and certificates.

trace.title: Individual traceability
trace.lead: Uruguay identifies every animal from birth. The plant keeps that link at every stage, all the way to the box label.

field.title: Identification on the farm
field.text: Every calf carries two ear tags with the same number, one visual and one electronic, fitted at the farm of origin.

registry.title: National system
registry.text: The number is recorded in the national livestock information system, together with every move between farms.

reception.title: Arrival at the plant
reception.text: On arrival the tags are read and the movement permit and producer declaration are checked. The lot is linked to its producer.

slaughter.title: Slaughter
slaughter.text: Each side of beef gets a label with the animal's number, which stays with it while it chills in the cold rooms.

boning.title: Boning
boning.text: Cuts are linked to the boning lot and the carcass sides it contains, recorded in the plant's system.

box.title: Coded box
box.text: Every box carries a barcode label: cut, production date, lot and the plant's approval number.

welfare.title: Animal welfare
welfare.lead: Animal welfare is an obligation and also a condition for meat quality. We apply it throughout the journey to the plant and inside it.

transport.title: Transport
transport.text: Approved trucks, loads within the recommended density and trained drivers. Trips are planned to be short and without waiting times.

rest.title: Rest in pens
rest.text: Animals rest in pens with permanent water and shade before slaughter, kept apart by lot of origin.

handling.title: Handling
handling.text: Curved races and non-slip floors, with no electric prods as routine practice. Staff are trained every year.

stunning.title: Stunning
stunning.text: Stunning before slaughter in line with current regulations, with effectiveness checks recorded on every shift.

audits.title: Audits
audits.text: Internal and customer audits using recognised protocols. Results are reviewed with producers and hauliers.

control.title: Quality control
control.lead: Quality is checked at every stage, from the arrival of the cattle to the loading of the container.

vet.title: Official veterinary inspection
vet.text: Official veterinarians inspect the live animals and every carcass on the slaughter line. No product leaves without their approval.

lab.title: Laboratory
lab.text: Microbiological testing of surfaces and product, plus sampling under the national residue programme. Results are linked to each lot.

cold.title: Cold chain
cold.text: Temperature is logged continuously in cold rooms, blast freezing tunnels and containers, with alarms and a check before every load.

Company.metaDescription: Family-owned meat packer founded in {founded} in Sarandí del Yí. Our history, a five-stage tour of the plant and the team that serves buyers and producers.
Company.title: A family-owned plant built for export
Company.lead: Since {founded}, the {family} family has processed cattle from central Uruguay in Sarandí del Yí. Today we export to more than {countries} countries with a team of {employees} people.

history.title: History
history.lead: More than five decades of step-by-step growth, always in the same place.

plant.title: Plant tour
plant.lead: Five stages, from the arrival of the cattle to the loading of the container.

reception.title: Reception
reception.text: Cattle arrive, ear tags are read, live animals are inspected by a veterinarian and rest in pens.

slaughter.title: Processing
slaughter.text: Carried out under continuous official inspection, on separate lines for cattle and sheep.

boning.title: Boning
boning.text: Temperature-controlled rooms where each market's cuts are prepared and vacuum-packed.

cold.title: Cold storage
cold.text: Chilling rooms and blast freezing tunnels, with capacity for {tonnes} tonnes.

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.text: Temperature-controlled loading of refrigerated containers, bound for the port of Montevideo.

team.title: Team

Producers.title: Sell your livestock at clear prices
Producers.lead: A weekly reference price board, a calculator to estimate your lot and buyers who cover your area. Offer your livestock in a couple of minutes.

board.title: Price board
board.lead: Reference purchase prices for the six categories, valid for the week, with the change from the previous week.
board.unitText: Prices are in US dollars per kilo of carcass weight (US$/kg carcass): they are paid on the weight of the carcass after slaughter, not on live weight.
board.finalPrice: The final price of each lot depends on carcass grading, the actual carcass yield and any applicable premiums, for example for finishing or certified programmes.
board.previous: The change is measured against the previous week's board.

steps.title: How to sell to the plant

offer.title: Offer
offer.text: Tell us the category, number of head, estimated weight and availability date: through the form, on WhatsApp or with the buyer for your area.

visit.title: Buyer visit
visit.text: A livestock buyer visits the farm, inspects the lot and estimates yield and finishing.

agreement.title: Price and date agreed
agreement.text: The price per kilo of carcass, the premiums and the delivery date at the plant are agreed.

transport.title: Transport
transport.text: The livestock travels with the usual paperwork: the ownership and transit permit (guía de propiedad y tránsito) and the producer's DICOSE number.

settlement.title: Slaughter, grading and settlement
settlement.text: Each carcass is weighed and graded. You receive a detailed settlement and payment within 30 days (fictitious term).

Privacy.metaDescription: What data this demo site stores, why and for how long.
Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.lead: This is a demo site for a fictitious company, but its forms store real data. Here we explain which data, why and for how long.

demo.title: A demo site
demo.text: Frigorífico Cuchilla Grande does not exist: it is a fictitious company created to showcase the design and development work of fourvexa.com. No offer or enquiry sent from this site leads to a real purchase, visit or business contact.

what.title: What we store
what.text: When you send a form we store:

items.fields: The details you entered: for example, livestock category and number of head, department, availability date, name, phone, email (if provided) and comments.
items.technical: The date and time of the submission, the site language and the environment (production or testing).
items.ip: An encrypted fingerprint of your connection: a hash of your IP address with a secret key. We do not store the IP; the fingerprint is only used to limit repeated submissions.

why.title: Why
why.text: Only so the form works end to end and to prevent abuse. We do not use the data for advertising, we do not sell or share it with third parties, and we will not contact you.

where.title: Where it is stored
where.text: In a Supabase database in the São Paulo region (Brazil). The site is hosted on Vercel. Both providers process the data only to deliver that service.

retention.title: For how long
retention.text: Submissions are deleted automatically after 90 days by a daily task run by the site itself.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: If you want us to delete a submission sooner, or to know whether we hold any of your data, write to <mail>{email}</mail> with your name and the approximate date of the submission.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: The site uses a single technical cookie (NEXT_LOCALE) to remember your chosen language. There are no advertising or analytics cookies.
